title: quick bouncy-qq tunisian solo-dinner tacos
description: a unique fusion dish featuring crispy tacos filled with spicy tuna, tobiko, and pickled turnip, inspired by the bold flavors of tunisia. best served as a single serving for a solo dinner or a light lunch.

ingredients.name: tunisian chili peppers
ingredients.notes: such as shatta or harissa peppers

instructions: mix tuna sashimi with cumin, paprika, salt, and chopped parsley in a bowl.
heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
add tunisian chili peppers to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
add the tuna mixture to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon.
warm corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
assemble the tacos by spooning the tuna mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of tobiko and a sprinkle of pickled turnip.
serve immediately and garnish with lemon juice and crushed red pepper.
